content_data.project_description: A proposal for a visually striking and interactive pop-up retail experience to launch our new sustainable fashion line, fostering brand immersion and regional market engagement.
content_data.timeline: Over the next 4 months, structured in discovery, design, fabrication, and activation phases.
objectives: Generate pre-orders for the new sustainable line.
Increase brand awareness by 25% in target regional markets.
Establish a strong, innovative brand perception.
deliverables: Comprehensive 3D concept renderings and spatial layouts.
Interactive experience flowcharts and content strategy.
content_data.design_style: Minimalist-futuristic with natural textures, focused on immersive digital integration and sustainable aesthetics.
creative_requirements: Needs to be highly Instagrammable and shareable.
